pages: A recording, still looping in a dead terminal. The voice is thin. Familiar.

pages.text: "If you're hearing this, the split held. We didn't. Nobody on the lower levels made it out before the seal."
"You told us the Disciplines would keep us. That we'd persist, individual and intact, inside something larger."
"It doesn't feel like persisting. It feels like being read. Constantly. Forever."
"I hope it worked. I hope you forgot.
I hope it hurts when you remember."

pages: The recording ends. Then it starts again.
